storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/fmcsaoos/ by CAPTURE date (gz after 2 days)
written_by: server/fmcsaOutOfService.ts archiveOosOrders (6h poll; change-only dedup keeps quiet cycles nearly free; eager boot)
source: FMCSA Out-of-Service Orders, data.transportation.gov Socrata dataset p2mt-9ige — keyless JSON. Verified live 2026-09-28: trailing-30-day count 2532 rows (~536/week), max(oos_date) within 2 days of the probe, status distinct ACTIVE/INACTIVE/PENDING. A sibling dataset on the same host (AuthHist - All With History, 9mw4-x3tu) was probed FIRST and REJECTED: its own description states it was 'last refreshed on 05/14/2026 and will no longer be updated', confirmed by max(orig_served_date)/max(disp_decided_date) both capping at 12/31/2025 despite a fresh-looking catalog timestamp.

field_map.dot_number|oos_date|status|rescind_date|: an unchanged order re-polled within 6h writes nothing; a status/rescind_date change (e.g. later rescission) appends
field_map.oos_date: as published, YYYY-MM-DD; only orders inside the trailing 45-day window are queried each poll
field_map.oos_reason: as published verbatim (e.g. 'New Entrant Revoked - Refusal of Audit/No Contact', 'Unsatisfactory = Unfit', '90 day failure to pay fine')
field_map.rescind_date: as published if present, else null; a record whose rescind_date is added AFTER its oos_date ages out of the 45-day window will not be re-observed (known v1 limitation)

confidence_model: RAW official enforcement-action log (RAW OVERLAYS vs SIGNALS, CLAUDE.md) — no predictive claim, no ladder gating required to surface it. EDGE DOCTRINE #2 (fish where whales can't): OOS orders hit almost exclusively small, non-public motor carriers; the dominant live-probed reason code ('New Entrant Revoked') specifically captures brand-new authorities failing their first safety audit — small-carrier formation/failure churn no equity desk tracks name-by-name. A SEPARATE, NOT YET ATTEMPTED hypothesis (aggregate OOS order volume vs. trucking-sector forward returns) is filed in research/open_questions.md, discounted up front per REASONING STANDARD #4 as the same shape the 2026-09-28 rail-carload GATE 2 test just rejected.
geo_fields: (dot_number -> no address/coordinates in this dataset; a company-registration join would be needed for a map layer, not attempted)
